Name: Farmer'Toxic EX
Author: Arimlaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=5]"Some exes leave a scar. This one moved into Pelican Town."[/size]

Ever felt like Stardew Valley was a bit too perfect? Like every bachelor and bachelorette is just too sweet, too safe, and too eager to please? It’s time for a harsh reality check.
The Toxic Ex-Boyfriend Mod introduces Ebuian, your narsst, manipulative, and deeply possessive ex who tracks you down all the way to the valley. He rents a room at the Saloon, infiltrates your new life, and turns the peaceful country atmosphere into a gripping psychological thriller. He will gaslight you, criticize your choices, ruin town festivals with jealousy fits, and try to isolate you from your friends.

This is not a fluffy romance mod.[/color]
